instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/gui05_bracket_dimension_seed.dxf. Do not move the existing outline or holes. Add complete dimension annotation: overall length 160 mm, overall height 90 mm, left hole distance 30 mm from the left edge, right hole distance 30 mm from the right edge, and two diameter 12 mm hole notes. Put every dimension entity or equivalent dimension text on layer DIM and set dimension text height to 3.5 mm. Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui05_bracket_dimension_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
